entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Look, expression, gaze; Grin, leer, sneer, smirk
entries.zh: 神情、表情、凝视；咧嘴笑、恶意的笑、讥笑、得意的假笑。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, chilly, icy, empty, expressionless; Nasty, cruel, evil, spiteful, vicious, venomous, callous, vengeful, malicious; Creepy, scary, hideous, monstrous, ghastly, demonic, moronic; Sly, cunning, furtive, sinister; Arrogant, sarcastic
entries.zh: 冷漠、冷淡、冰冷、空洞、毫无表情；恶劣、残忍、邪恶、恶意、凶狠、狠毒、无情、心怀报复、恶毒；令人毛骨悚然、吓人、丑恶、怪物般、惨厉、恶魔般、愚钝；狡猾、诡诈、鬼祟、阴险；傲慢、讽刺。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Stared, glared, glanced; Grinned, grimaced, sneered
entries.zh: 盯着、瞪视、瞥；咧嘴笑、扭曲表情、讥笑。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Smile as empty as a carcass
entries.zh: 笑容像空壳尸体一样毫无温度

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a grinning snake
entries.zh: 像一条咧嘴笑的蛇

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Vicious smile
entries.zh: 凶狠的笑容

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Unpleasant, sarcastic smile
entries.zh: 令人不快的讽刺笑容

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Slow, demonic leer
entries.zh: 缓缓露出的恶魔般狞笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Reptilian sneer
entries.zh: 爬行动物般阴冷的讥笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Leering smile
entries.zh: 带恶意的笑容

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, sinister look
entries.zh: 冷漠阴险的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Furtive, viperish expression
entries.zh: 鬼祟而毒蛇般的表情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, arrogant expression
entries.zh: 冷漠傲慢的表情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Amused, callous look
entries.zh: 冷酷地看笑话的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Ghastly smile of pretended sympathy
entries.zh: 假装同情的可怕笑容

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Dramatic expression of mock concern and sympathy
entries.zh: 夸张地装出关心与同情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lips twisted briefly
entries.zh: 嘴唇短暂地扭了一下

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Face split into a nasty, demonic grin
entries.zh: 脸上裂开一道恶魔般的坏笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Twisted in a malicious smirk
entries.zh: 扭出恶意的假笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Mouth stretched in a hideous sneer
entries.zh: 咧嘴露出丑恶的讥笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bared teeth
entries.zh: 龇出牙齿

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Stretched his mouth into a grisly smile
entries.zh: 咧出一个令人毛骨悚然的笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Face wrinkled with disgust
entries.zh: 脸因厌恶而皱起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shot him a withering look
entries.zh: 朝他投去令人畏缩的一瞥

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Directed look of purest venom
entries.zh: 投去怨毒至极的目光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Features tightened with contempt
entries.zh: 五官因轻蔑而绷紧

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Trained his steely gaze on her
entries.zh: 把冷硬的目光对准她

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His pale, skull-like face split into an evil grin.
entries.zh: 他苍白如骷髅的脸上裂开一个邪恶的笑容。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He curled his lips into a savage sneer.
entries.zh: 他卷起嘴唇，露出残酷的讥笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She directed a look of pure venom at his retreating back.
entries.zh: 她朝他渐渐远去的背影投去怨毒的目光。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His smile was as empty as a carcass.
entries.zh: 他的笑容空洞得像一具尸体。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her expression suddenly changed to a dramatic look of mock concern and sympathy.
entries.zh: 她突然换了表情，夸张地装出关切和同情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She took aim with an invisible gun and gave him a slow, demonic leer.
entries.zh: 她用一把看不见的枪瞄准，朝他缓缓露出恶魔般的狞笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His mouth twisted into a smirk and his icy blue eyes narrowed to slits.
entries.zh: 他的嘴扭成假笑，冰蓝的眼睛眯成细缝。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert trained his steely gaze on her and stretched his mouth into a grisly smile.
entries.zh: 罗伯特把冷硬的目光对准她，咧出一个可怕的笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He raised his eyebrows and glanced at her with a cold, arrogant expression.
entries.zh: 他扬起眉毛，神情冷漠傲慢地瞥了她一眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had an amused, callous look on his face, as he watched Kitty writhing on the floor.
entries.zh: 看着基蒂在地上扭动，他脸上露出冷酷而觉得有趣的表情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As he opened the door for them to leave, his mouth twisted into a knowing grin.
entries.zh: 他为他们开门让他们离开时，嘴角扭出心照不宣的坏笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Snorting with contempt, he bared his yellow teeth in a reptilian sneer.
entries.zh: 他轻蔑地哼了一声，露出黄牙，阴冷地讥笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His mouth curled with revulsion, as she made a despairing lunge at his arm.
entries.zh: 她绝望地伸手抓他的手臂，他厌恶得卷起了嘴角。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Look, stare, glare, slits
entries.zh: 目光、盯视、怒视、细缝。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Small, little, beady, buggy, staring, unblinking; Hard, cold, ice cold, frosty, steely; Sharp, evil, cruel, piercing, withering; Ghostly, monstrous, feverish, demon-haunted
entries.zh: 小、细小、珠子般、凸出、直盯、一眨不眨；冷硬、冷漠、冰冷、霜冻般、钢铁般；锐利、邪恶、残酷、穿透、令人畏缩；幽灵般、怪物般、狂热、恶魔附体般。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Stared, squinted, narrowed, bulged, flickered, drilled, blasted; Darkened, burned, blazed, glinted, sparkled
entries.zh: 凝视、眯眼、眯起、凸出、闪动、钻视、猛烈逼视；阴沉、燃烧、炽燃、闪光、闪耀。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, steely eyes
entries.zh: 冷漠、钢铁般的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Small and hard as raisins
entries.zh: 像葡萄干一样又小又硬

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Buggy little eyes
entries.zh: 小而凸出的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Piercing like razors
entries.zh: 像剃刀般锐利

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Frosty and narrowed
entries.zh: 冰冷地眯起眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Crafty look
entries.zh: 狡黠的眼神

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Demon-haunted expression
entries.zh: 恶魔附体般的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Glinted evilly
entries.zh: 闪着邪恶的光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sparkled like frost – cold and dangerous
entries.zh: 像霜一样闪光，冰冷而危险

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Burned with a cruel light
entries.zh: 眼里燃着残酷的光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Drilled into her
entries.zh: 逼视着她，仿佛钻入她心里

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His small eyes were as dark and hard as raisins and had a demon-haunted expression.
entries.zh: 他的小眼睛像葡萄干一样黑硬，透着恶魔般的神情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She stared at Kitty for a moment and then a crafty look flickered in her buggy little eyes.
entries.zh: 她盯着基蒂片刻，小而凸出的眼睛里闪过狡黠的神色。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He stared with unblinking eyes, but his lips twisted in a sneer.
entries.zh: 他一眨不眨地盯着，嘴唇却扭成讥笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His feverish, staring eyes bulged in his monstrous face.
entries.zh: 他狂热而直勾勾的双眼，在怪物般的脸上凸出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She stared with eyes that sparkled like frost – cold and dangerous.
entries.zh: 她的眼睛像霜一样闪着光，冰冷危险地凝视着。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Tone, hiss, whisper, snort, giggle; Snarl, shout, screech, shriek, laughter
entries.zh: 语气、嘶声、耳语、鼻哼、咯咯笑；咆哮、喊叫、尖鸣、尖叫、笑声。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Cold, icy, chilly, frosty, harsh, cruel, sharp; Mocking, spiteful, vicious, threatening, venomous
entries.zh: 冷淡、冰冷、冷漠、霜冷、严厉、残酷、尖刻；嘲弄、恶意、凶狠、威胁、怨毒。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Sneered, sniggered, snorted, jeered
entries.zh: 讥笑、窃笑、嗤鼻、嘲弄。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Frosty voice
entries.zh: 冷若冰霜的声音

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Tone was firm and chilly
entries.zh: 语气坚定而冰冷

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Tone was chiselled with menace
entries.zh: 语气里刻满威胁

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Voice was cold and cruel
entries.zh: 声音冷酷无情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Voice of ice cold venom
entries.zh: 带着冰冷恶意的声音

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Splinter of ice in her voice
entries.zh: 声音里仿佛藏着一片冰碴

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Voice was low, cold and full of menace
entries.zh: 声音低沉、冰冷，充满威胁

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Stifled snort
entries.zh: 强忍的一声鼻哼

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Scornful giggle
entries.zh: 轻蔑的窃笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Sneering shout
entries.zh: 带着讥讽的大喊

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Screech like a seagull
entries.zh: 像海鸥一样尖鸣

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Threatening, venomous hiss
entries.zh: 威胁而怨毒的嘶声

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Ghostly whisper
entries.zh: 幽灵般的耳语

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Manic laughter
entries.zh: 疯狂的大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Snort of mocking laughter
entries.zh: 带嘲弄的一声喷笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Voice was full of malicious laughter
entries.zh: 声音里满是恶意的笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Responded coldly
entries.zh: 冷冷回应

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Added nastily
entries.zh: 恶狠狠地补充

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Said in a low, vicious tone
entries.zh: 用低沉凶狠的语气说

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Ordered with a sneer of cold command
entries.zh: 带着冷酷命令的讥笑发号施令

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Snorted with disgust
entries.zh: 厌恶地哼了一声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Snarled like a vicious dog
entries.zh: 像恶狗一样咆哮

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Laughed scornfully
entries.zh: 轻蔑地笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bored into her like a drill
entries.zh: 像钻头一样钻进她耳里

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Chilled her to the bone
entries.zh: 使她感到彻骨的寒意

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sharp words slashed the air
entries.zh: 尖刻的话语像刀一样划破空气

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Every word he spoke dripped with venom and hate.
entries.zh: 他说出的每个字都浸透恶意与仇恨。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She drew in her breath in a venomous hiss.
entries.zh: 她吸了一口气，发出充满恶意的嘶声。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His hard, cold eyes and frosty voice chilled Kitty to the bone.
entries.zh: 他冷硬的双眼和冰霜般的嗓音，让基蒂浑身发冷。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She threw back her head and laughed like a screeching seagull.
entries.zh: 她仰头大笑，声音像海鸥尖叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her eyes narrowed dangerously and then she laughed scornfully.
entries.zh: 她危险地眯起双眼，然后轻蔑地笑了。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a haunting voice, and one that visited her nightly in her dreams – a voice of ice-cold venom.
entries.zh: 那声音阴魂不散，每晚都会进入她的梦里，带着冰冷的恶意。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was used to giving orders; his tone was firm and cold and one that expected to be obeyed without question.
entries.zh: 他习惯发号施令，语气冷而坚定，理所当然地要求别人无条件服从。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His tone was so sharp that the words seemed to slash the air.
entries.zh: 他的语气尖刻得仿佛每个字都在割裂空气。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Snake, cobra, lizard, panther, peacock, cat; Shadow, ghost; Predator, prey
entries.zh: 蛇、眼镜蛇、蜥蜴、豹子、孔雀、猫；影子、幽灵；捕食者、猎物。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Dark, quiet, silent; Still, motionless, invisible; Quick, deft, pecking, scuttling
entries.zh: 黑暗、安静、无声；静止、一动不动、隐形；迅速、灵巧、啄食般点动、急窜。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Moved, glided, ran, strutted; Pointed, jerked, flexed; Dismissed, beckoned
entries.zh: 移动、滑行、奔跑、趾高气扬地走；指、猛动、屈伸；打发走、招手。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a dark ghost
entries.zh: 像黑暗中的幽灵

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a scuttling lizard
entries.zh: 像迅速窜动的蜥蜴

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a figure carved from stone
entries.zh: 像石头雕成的人像

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Silent and motionless
entries.zh: 无声无息，一动不动

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a predator scenting its prey
entries.zh: 像嗅到猎物的捕食者

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a panther waiting to pounce
entries.zh: 像等待扑出的豹子

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: As silent as a shadow
entries.zh: 像影子一样无声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Raised to his full height
entries.zh: 把身体挺到最高

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Broadened shoulders
entries.zh: 展开宽阔的肩膀

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Leaned forward menacingly
entries.zh: 充满威胁地向前倾身

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Poised on the balls of his feet
entries.zh: 用前脚掌支撑，蓄势待发

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Crouched on the edge
entries.zh: 蹲伏在边缘

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Landed quietly like a cat
entries.zh: 像猫一样轻轻落地

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Advanced slowly
entries.zh: 缓慢逼近

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Strutted like a peacock
entries.zh: 像孔雀一样趾高气扬地走

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Glided like a shadow
entries.zh: 像影子一样滑过

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Moved stealthily
entries.zh: 悄无声息地移动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Glided noiselessly like a dark ghost
entries.zh: 像黑暗幽灵般无声飘行

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Ran in pecking strides
entries.zh: 迈着啄食般急促的小步奔跑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Flexed his fingers and formed them into a fist
entries.zh: 屈伸手指，然后握成拳头

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Beckoned them to come to him
entries.zh: 招手叫他们过来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Dismissed them with a wave of her hand
entries.zh: 挥手打发他们走

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He landed quietly like a cat.
entries.zh: 他像猫一样无声地落地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was crouched on the edge, like a panther waiting to pounce.
entries.zh: 他蹲伏在边缘，像一头等待扑出的豹子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He beckoned them to him with a tense jerk of his fingers.
entries.zh: 他紧绷着手指勾动一下，示意他们靠近。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She dismissed them with a wave of her hand.
entries.zh: 她挥挥手，打发他们离开。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was as silent and motionless as a figure carved from stone.
entries.zh: 他像石雕一样安静，一动不动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He stood still and poised, like a cobra about to strike.
entries.zh: 他静立着蓄势待发，像一条马上要攻击的眼镜蛇。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty leaned forward and grimaced at him malevolently.
entries.zh: 基蒂前倾身子，对他露出恶意的狰狞表情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was tensed, poised on the balls of his feet, like a predator scenting its prey.
entries.zh: 他身体绷紧，重心压在前脚掌上，像嗅到猎物的捕食者。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He flexed his fingers, formed them into a fist and advanced menacingly.
entries.zh: 他屈伸手指，握成拳头，带着威胁逼近。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Gliding smoothly, noiselessly in the shadows, she was like a dark ghost.
entries.zh: 她在阴影里平滑而无声地移动，像黑暗中的幽灵。
